# `ereport` Function Documentation

## Documentation Summary 
This section provides detailed documentation of the `ereport` function across various PostgreSQL backend access components (`brin`, `reloptions`, `ginscan`, etc.). The doc will cover its purpose, parameter descriptions, usage patterns, impact analysis, and cross-references within related modules.

## 1. Function Docs


### General Description
The `ereport` function is used throughout the PostgreSQL backend system primarily for error reporting purposes. It logs errors or warnings from different parts of the system during database operations such as index creation, table modifications, constraint enforcement, etc. This function helps identify issues by providing context-specific messages that point developers towards potential problems.

#### Common Use Cases  
- Logging errors/warnings from database operations
- Alerting users/administrators about critical issues
- Debugging and troubleshooting database-related functionality

---

### Parameter Descriptions
```
ANY(2) -> Denotes two arguments passed into this general-purpose logging mechanism, typically an error level (e.g., ERROR, WARNING, DEBUG, LOG) followed by a message string.
```

| Argument | Type   | Required | Default Value |
|-|-|-|-|
| Error Level | Integer Constant | Yes | N/A |
| Message | String | No | N/A |

---

### Return Values
No specific return value; this function mainly serves to log messages internally and may terminate execution depending on severity levels like fatal errors.

---

### Usage Examples
```sql
-- Example from brin.c
EREPORT(ERROR,
        (errmsg("BRIN index requires a valid column type")));

-- Example from reloptions.c
EREPORT(LOG,
        (errmsg("Option %s not supported", option_name)));

-- Example from heapam.c
EREPORT(FATAL,
        (errcode(ERRCODE_INTERNAL_ERROR),
         errmsg("Failed HEAPAM operation")));
```
